summary_en: 1,700,000 shares (8.06% S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at closing price ¥1,524/share; ¥2.601B aggregate limit; single-day execution 2026-08-21 08:45 JST; stated reason: mitigate short-term supply impact from major shareholder sale, preserve existing shareholders' interests, enable agile capital policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-20, S.T.CORPORATION's board approved acquisition of up to 1,700,000 treasury shares (8.06% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading on 2026-08-21 at the prior day's closing price of ¥1,524 per share, for an aggregate limit of ¥2.601 billion. The execution will occur at 08:45 JST and is limited to that single time window; the buy order will be contingent on matching sell orders. The stated rationale is to mitigate short-term supply pressure and preserve existing shareholders' interests following notification from a major shareholder of intent to sell a material position, while also preserving management's flexibility to execute responsive capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. Results will be disclosed upon trading completion.
